# The server's target date lives in ServerTuning.csv as EraDate (yyyymmdd
# client 4.95 shipped). Set EraDate to 0 to switch era gating off entirely.
# Feature      the key Era.Has() is called with. Server/Era.cs declares the ones our code asks about as
#              consts; a row whose key nothing reads yet is fine and is the normal state for a date we
#              have researched but not wired up.
# Introduced   first day the feature existed (inclusive). Blank = as far back as we know.
# Retired      first day it no longer existed (EXCLUSIVE — gone ON this date). Blank = still present.
#              A feature that MOVED rather than vanished retires on the day its replacement is introduced.
# Source       Sources.csv SourceId backing the date.

column5: The separate tutorial AREA (maps 4711-4718). Dated from the TSWolf news run 2000-09-29 'Friday! TGIF!!!' through 2000-10-09 'Little Break'; earliest surviving documentation of it is Jan 2001. The tutor NPCs themselves are older and are never gated.

The tutor-delivered first-steps beats (wooden saber, 10 rabbits, spring garb, 10 squirrels, Soothe). Did not vanish -- MOVED into the newbie area -- so it retires the day the area opens and exactly one of the pair is ever live. Server/NoviceQuest.cs.
Tutorial stage 11, the missing-brother/Haguru quest. Du Mountain and Haguru himself are OLDER ('stranded on the mountain in early 4.0') and stay present when this is off -- only the quest is gated.

Tutorial stage 13. Shipped the same day as the Du Mountain quest: 'there are 2 new ones at the end. One of them is the Du mountain quest, and the other one is the Student cap quest' (TSWolf 2001-03-19).

The Druid bouquet quest (Sophie/Sebastian in Elder's Hideaway -> Yarlof's flower test on Du Mountain). Nearly four years AFTER our target date, and the only gate so far that removes an NPC rather than muting one: Yarlof exists for this quest and nothing else, so he is placed via NPCs.csv EraFeature. Haguru shares map 1321 and is untouched -- he is 4.0-era.
